description: State Highway Network Postmiles Tenth is a dataset listed in Caltrans GIS Data hub, an open geospatial data hub of a state transportation department, published or maintained by Caltrans. Postmiles are valid postmile points at 0.1 (1/10th) mile intervals, based on the Caltrans Linear Referencing System. Exceptions that are included are the beginning and ends of routes (and other situations) that don't necessarily begin or end on the even 0.1 mile interval. Coverage: California, United States. The hub lists this as a dataset of Caltrans. Its keywords are CAOpenData, CalSTA, California Department of Transportation, California State Transportation Agency, Caltrans, Postmiles, Transportation, Highway. The bounding box given is -124.2649,32.5443,-114.2983,42.0055. The hub shows 2025-08-11 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is a licence or disclaimer text is given on the hub listing (Postmiles is made available to the public solely for informational purposes.
